name: Further Than Memory
source:
The year is 2045, and the future has brought about many new problems. Mars is a victim of one such problem. Because an upcoming operation to remove a faulty implant from his brain will cause him to lose most of his memories, he has one chance to enjoy one last day with his friends. Who will he choose to be with, and can they grant him one final memory to carry into his uncertain future?

[From [url=https://seyosays.itch.io/further-than-memory]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今年是2045年，未来带来了许多新问题。火星就是此类问题的受害者。因为即将进行的从大脑中移除有缺陷的植入物的手术将导致他失去大部分记忆，所以他有机会与朋友们一起享受最后的一天。他会选择和谁在一起，他们能否给予他最后的记忆，带入他不确定的未来？

[来自[url=https://seyosays.itch.io/further-than-memory]Itch.io[/url]]
